title: F20–F29: Schizophrenia
author: Dr. Mayurakshi Katiyar
footnote: Source: Davidson's Principles & Practice of Medicine, 24th ed (p1251–1253) · ICD-10 sub-codes: WHO · For medical students · Educational, not treatment advice

slides.line: Duniya mein har 200 mein se 1 insaan ko schizophrenia (prevalence ~0.5%)
slides.cta: Mardon mein zyada (1.4 : 1) · shuruaat aksar mid-20s mein

slides.title: Schizophrenia kya hai?
items: Lack of insight: 'main bimaar nahi hoon'
Ya dheere dheere: social withdrawal (negative symptoms)

slides.title: Ek block, 8 codes
slides.note: ⚠ Sub-codes: WHO ICD-10 (not in Davidson). Davidson Box 31.1: F20–F29 schizophrenia and delusional disorders.

slides.title: Bas ABCD yaad karo
qa: 2nd/3rd person voices · thoughts echo (écho de la pensée)
Feelings, impulses, acts koi aur control kar raha (passivity)
Normal cheez dekhi, ajeeb matlab nikaal liya

slides.title: Schizophrenia vs Organic

left.name: Schizophrenia
items: Awaaz sir ke bahar se, uske baare mein baat

slides.note: Taste/smell hallucinations → temporal lobe epilepsy socho

slides.title: "Mere thoughts koi chura raha hai"
items: Thought withdrawal: dimaag se thoughts nikaale ja rahe
Thought broadcast: sab ko pata chal raha
Thought insertion: bahar ke thoughts daale ja rahe
Delusions of control: koi aur chala raha hai
Delusional perception: 'Chaand dekha, turant samjha wo evil hai'

slides.title: Chup, akela, sust: ye bhi schizophrenia
Positive vs Negative

right.name: Negative (chronic)
items: Acute phase ke baad bachte hain

slides.note: Acute ke baad aksar negative symptoms reh jaate hain

slides.title: Catatonia aur thought disorder
items: Thought disorder: samajh na aane wali speech
Ya ajeeb postures mein ruka rehta hai
Ye bhi schizophrenia ke symptoms ho sakte hain

slides.title: Genes + environment + trigger
items: Bahut saare genes, har ek ka chhota asar

slides.line: Ek parent ko ho to bachche ka risk ~10%. Identical twin ko ho to 50%
slides.cta: Neurodevelopmental disorder: genes se shuru, trigger se bhadakta hai

slides.title: Cannabis = chingaari
items: Acute schizophrenia episode trigger kar sakta hai
Lambe heavy use se schizophrenia ka risk badhta hai
Young patient + psychosis? Drug history zaroor lo

slides.title: Ilaaj: dawa + parivaar + samaaj
items: First episode: aksar admission (insight nahi hoti)
Antipsychotics: positive symptoms par ~2 hafte mein asar
Relapse rokne ke liye lamba treatment, depot injection
CBT + family education se relapse kam
Rehab: ghar, kaam, health worker ka saath

slides.title: Dawa ke side-effects pehchano
items: EPSE: acute dystonia, akathisia, parkinsonism, tardive dyskinesia
NMS: fever, rigidity, autonomic instability, delirium

slides.line: ⅓ achha outcome · ⅓ relapse ke saath recover · ⅓ chronic
slides.cta: Up to 10% suicide · heart disease, diabetes, stroke ka risk zyada
